benefits.name: Dining Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible purchases at restaurants worldwide.
benefits.terms: Up to $25 per month ($300/year total). Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Award every year after card renewal month, redeemable at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel with a redemption level at or under 85,000 points.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status, plus 25 Elite Night Credits toward the next elite tier each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Automatic with cardmembership; requires a linked Marriott Bonvoy account. 25 Elite Night Credits awarded each calendar year.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership with unlimited visits to over 1,300 airport lounges in over 130 countries.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Unlimited visits under Priority Pass Select enrollment.

benefits.terms: Requires enrollment in Priority Pass Select through American Express.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry (up to $120) or TSA PreCheck (up to $85) application fee, every 4 years.
benefits.terms: Up to $120 for Global Entry or up to $85 for TSA PreCheck, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Ritz-Carlton / St. Regis Property Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for qualifying charges during a stay of at least two nights at a Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis property.
benefits.terms: Requires a minimum two-night stay booked as a qualifying rate. Applies per qualifying stay rather than on a fixed renewal cycle.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses when a covered trip is cancelled or cut short.

earningRates.terms: Base card rate at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy; combined with member and Platinum Elite bonuses this can reach up to 21X.
Restaurants worldwide and flights booked directly with airlines.
